candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart creates a group of Marines as combat constructs

claim_citation.quote: John then uses his power to create a group of Marines, who fight alongside him against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John manifests a squad of Marine constructs to fight with him. This is a tactical/assisted battlefield use of the ring rather than a permanent creation.
candidates.title: Blackest Night Marine squad
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John summons a whole Marine unit that joins the fight against the Black Lanterns.

candidates.character_or_thing: John Stewart fires a sniper-rifle construct into Mogo’s core

claim_citation.quote: John constructs a sniper rifle and fires a bullet into Mogo's core, killing the living planet and stopping the creation of corrupted rings.

candidates.summary: Full construct feat: John builds a precise sniper rifle construct and uses it to deliver the finishing shot that kills Mogo. This is one of his most lethal and technically detailed constructs.
candidates.title: The Mogo sniper shot
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John manifests a sniper rifle, takes aim, and shoots a bullet straight into Mogo’s core.

claim_citation.quote: In despair, he creates a construct of his dead little sister, Ellie, to calm his mother.

candidates.summary: John makes a construct of his deceased younger sister to comfort his dementia-stricken mother. This is a temporary, emotional support construct that later becomes a bigger ongoing status-quo element.
candidates.title: Green Lantern: War Journal #5
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John conjures a girl-shaped Ellie construct in front of his mother and uses her presence to reassure her.

candidates.character_or_thing: Mosaic World city-splice / Oa city-brought-together construct work

claim_citation.quote: The deranged Guardian went insane and used John to form a mind-union and, tapping the power of Oa's core, to bring cities from different planets to form a patchwork of communities.

candidates.summary: John helps maintain the Mosaic World, a gigantic patchwork settlement made from transplanted cities. This is a large-scale, sustained creation/building feat rather than a quick combat construct.
candidates.title: Green Lantern: Mosaic #18
candidates.what_visibly_happens: John stands over the Mosaic and, in the issue, saves it from an attack and then keeps order while the various cities remain fused together on Oa.
